Hi there! The CSV export you ran hits the built‑in browser cap of 10,000 rows per download. To get the full data you have two options:

1. **Split the export** – narrow the date range or apply a filter so each export stays under 10,000 rows (e.g., export one month at a time) and then combine the files.
2. **Use a scheduled export** – set up a scheduled export to cloud storage (e.g., S3, Google Drive). Those exports aren’t limited by the 10‑k‑row browser cap and can pull the entire history.

Either approach will let you capture the full quarterly dataset. Let me know if you need help setting up the scheduled export!
